cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Aunt Jean he set it on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we all say, 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jean wants him to explain it in his birthday speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's his opening sentence too. Then straight to thanking her for the trifle.

mechanism: A organizes a shared account to protect Grandad, accommodates the known fire and helps B redirect the birthday speech.
confusable: Unlike demanding silence, A gives everyone a truthful short line and a cooperative way to use it.
comparison: Birthday family protection and trifle thanks differ from trip notices and parent concern.
